text: Afua's mum had a fall on Sunday and broke her wrist. She's having it set at the fracture clinic on Thursday at 10am. Remind me to text Afua that evening to see how it went.
Hugo said his daughter has been off school all week with tonsillitis. Poor thing can barely swallow.
Spoke to Yetunde on the phone. Her brother Kwame is getting married on 14 March 2027 in Accra, and she's already stressing about flights.

Andre's knee surgery is booked for 2 November 2026, first thing in the morning. He's quite nervous about the anaesthetic. I should message him the day before to wish him luck, and then check in the week after.
Jada mentioned her son has just been diagnosed with asthma. They're still getting used to the inhalers.
Need to pick up my prescription from the pharmacy tomorrow morning before work.
Santiago and Valentina's twins turn five on Saturday. They're doing a small party at the soft play place at 2pm.

Lena told me her dad is in hospital again with his heart. She's driving up to Leeds tonight and will probably stay until Monday. Her brother lives in Spain and can't get a flight until the weekend, so it's mostly on her for now. She said the doctors are talking about a pacemaker but nothing is decided. Don't forget to ring her on Wednesday evening.
Angela is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the Christmas dinner.
Rebecca's partner Mihai sprained his ankle playing five-a-side last night. He's on crutches for at least two weeks, which he is not happy about.
Nadia's little girl has her grommets operation on the 12th at half 9. Remind me to send Nadia a message that afternoon.
Coffee with Joanna. She's started a pottery class on Tuesday evenings and absolutely loves it. Her husband thinks it's a phase.
Aleksander, or Olek as everyone calls him, has been signed off work with a slipped disc. He's bored out of his mind at home.
Mateo's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is on Friday 30 October at 11am. I must send a card before then.

Dana said her mum's MRI results come back next Thursday. She's trying not to think about it, but she's clearly worried. Her mum has been having dizzy spells since the summer and keeps playing it down. Dana's sister is going with her to the appointment because Dana can't get the time off. I should text her Thursday night once she knows.
Anika's sister Meera is expecting her first baby in March 2027. Anika is going to be an auntie and can't stop talking about it.
Farid called to say the hiking trip in the Lakes is off. His brother broke his leg, so they're postponing until spring.
Aisha has a hospital appointment for her migraines on Monday at 3:30pm. Remind me to ask her how it went on Tuesday.
Bumped into Damian at the station. His wife has gone back to work after maternity leave and he's doing nursery drop-offs now.
Ahmed's dog Biscuit had to have a tooth removed at the vet this morning. Ahmed said she's groggy but fine.
Jonah is moving to Bristol at the end of November. His girlfriend got a job at the university there.
Keisha mentioned that her son Ethan has his first football match for the under-nines on Saturday morning. He's been practising in the garden every evening.
Bogdan's wife Joanna is having her gallbladder out on 9 December 2026. He'll be taking the week off to look after the kids. I should drop round a lasagne the day after she comes home.

Kevin has been really struggling since his dad went into the care home. He said visits are hard because his dad doesn't always recognise him. He goes on Sunday afternoons with his sister Angela, and they usually go for a drink afterwards to decompress. He also mentioned the house will have to be sold in the new year, which he's dreading. Must remember to ask him how this Sunday went.
Sunil is training for the Manchester half marathon in April 2027. He runs before work most mornings.
Gym at 7am tomorrow, then dentist at 11. Must remember to cancel the Thursday class.

Bruno's mum is coming over from Italy for three weeks in November. He's a bit anxious because she's recently had a hip replacement and the stairs in his flat are steep. He's thinking of giving her his bedroom and sleeping on the sofa. She lands at Gatwick on the 6th at about 4pm and his car is still in the garage, so I said I'd drive him there to pick her up.

Long call with Afua tonight. Her daughter Yetunde has glandular fever and has been in bed for nearly three weeks, so she's going to miss her mock exams on 16 November 2026. The school have been understanding, but Afua is exhausted from juggling it with work, and her husband is away on a contract in Aberdeen until Christmas. Remind me to check in with her on Friday, and maybe offer to do a school run next week.
Hugo's partner Valentina just got the all clear after her biopsy. Huge relief for both of them.
Andre says his little brother has his driving test on Wednesday at 8:40am. He's failed twice already and is a nervous wreck.
Lena is allergic to nuts and shellfish. Also prefers tea to coffee.
Mihai's daughter Ana starts reception in September 2027. They've just found out she got into the school round the corner.
Jada's dad had a mild stroke last weekend. He's home now and doing physio three times a week. Jada sounded tired but okay. Don't forget to ask how his speech is coming along when I see her on Sunday.
Rebecca and her husband are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 21 November. They're going to Lisbon for a long weekend.
Angela's son got the job at the bank! He starts on the 4th of January.
Remind me to text Kwame the morning of his interview. It's Tuesday at 10:15, and he's really nervous.
Valentina said her mother-in-law is staying with them for a month while she recovers from a knee replacement. Valentina is being very polite about it.
Nadia's husband Sunil was rushed in with appendicitis on Saturday night. He had keyhole surgery on Sunday and is hoping to be discharged tomorrow afternoon.
Dinner at Joanna and Bogdan's on Friday at 7:30. I'm bringing dessert.
Damian's brother is doing the London Marathon for a cancer charity. Damian mentioned he'd love a proper running watch for his birthday next month.
Santiago's son Mateo broke his arm falling off the trampoline. He's in a cast for six weeks and is very proud of all the signatures.
Aisha's parents celebrate their 40th wedding anniversary on 3 April 2027. She and her sisters are planning a surprise meal and I said I'd help with the invitations.

Farid told me he's been feeling quite low since the redundancy. He has a meeting with the job centre on Thursday morning. I should invite him for a pint the week after. He also mentioned his wife Aisha has been brilliant but the money worries are getting to both of them, and their eldest, Jonah, is applying to universities this winter.
Need to book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Keisha's mum, Mrs Okafor, has been in and out of hospital with pneumonia since August. Keisha is splitting her time between work and the ward.
Ethan said his partner Jonah has a sinus operation on Monday 23 November at 1pm. Remind me to send Jonah a get well soon message that evening.
Kevin collects vinyl, mostly old soul and jazz. Said he's been hunting for a first pressing of a Nina Simone album for years.
Called Anika to see how her dad's operation went last Thursday. It went well and he's already walking with a frame. She's going up to see him again this weekend.
Meera's daughter had a nasty bout of chickenpox, so they cancelled her sixth birthday party. They're hoping to rearrange it for some time in December.
Bruno and his wife are expecting their second baby. Due date is late May 2027.
Hugo's brother Bruno has just been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at 34. Hugo was really shaken.
Ahmed is starting a new job at the hospital on Monday at 8am. He's a bit nervous about the night shifts. Remind me to message him on Sunday evening.
Lovely chat with Dr Kumar after the clinic. Her son is off to university in Edinburgh next September and she's already dreading the empty house.
Andre mentioned that his mum is turning seventy on the 28th. He wants to get her something special. She loves gardening and has been dropping hints about a new greenhouse.

Spoke to Yetunde this morning. Her grandad's hip operation, which was meant to be on 5 November 2026, has been called off because of a bed shortage. No new date yet, and the whole family is frustrated. Her mum has been driving over every day to help him with shopping and his medication. Remind me to ring Yetunde next week to see if they've heard anything.
Must buy a birthday card for Uncle Farid before Saturday.
Dana's cat Pepper has gone missing. She's been out putting posters up since yesterday afternoon.
Sunil and Nadia are flying to Delhi on 18 December 2026 to see her grandmother, who isn't well. They'll be away until the middle of January.
Note to self: I'm taking Jada's mum to her eye appointment on Wednesday at half 2, then dropping her home. Need to fill up the car the night before.

Valentina's brother Santi had his first chemo session yesterday. She said he handled it better than expected but is completely wiped out today. Their parents are flying in from Madrid on the 3rd and staying until Christmas. I should send her something on Friday, maybe a food delivery, and remember to ask how the second session goes the week after.
